actual_request.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE production game sprite, an independently drawn full-body SOUTH-facing WALK frame 02 of a 16-frame 480ms walking cycle for character 20_star_formation_master_girl from 五行奇谈. One character, one pose, one square image. Native complete single frame 1024x1024 or larger. Actual transparent background alpha; no checkerboard painted into RGB.
Input image 1 is the authoritative character identity reference. Preserve this exact girl, face, large warm ruby-brown eyes, cheerful open smile, very large rounded head, compact short torso and legs, approximately 2.3 heads tall. Dark brown-black long straight hair with high half-up bun, ornate gold star crown, red star side ornament, tiny forehead star, small red tassels. Black and ivory Daoist robes with red front panels, warm gold star/cloud trim, red-gold star belt, loose ivory trousers, black/gold boots. Right hand (viewer left in this front view) holds her short-handled circular charcoal/gold STAR ASTROLABE with concentric orbit rings, central red star jewel and attached short red tassels. Left hand holds exactly THREE connected physical black/gold star talisman cards with red centers. Keep both equipment items complete and attached to hands. No weapon swap, no added equipment.
Input image 2 is the approved PRIMARY RENDERING STYLE reference only: bright clean rounded refined hand-painted Chinese Daoist chibi fantasy, gentle painted volume, crisp readable silhouette, restrained gold materials. Do not copy the UI layout, green costume, male face or text from it. Identity and costume colors remain exactly image 1.
Input image 3 is previous South walking frame01, used ONLY to lock same character size, camera, material, equipment proportions. It is NOT the requested pose. Draw the different specified phase.
POSE: SOUTH/front, frame 02 of 16 at 30 milliseconds per frame. Anatomical LEFT foot (screen right) has just taken full weight ahead, its sole settles firmly. Pelvis dips very slightly. Anatomical RIGHT heel rises from the rear ground; right knee begins to bend and right toe is just leaving ground. Short grounded walk; no airborne pair. Preserve mild continuous counter-movement of robe panels, sleeve tips, long hair and attached tassels, but keep stable head shape and equipment. Both boots must be visible and complete; no crossed legs. At least one boot supports on ground at every frame. All head/torso/hips point straight SOUTH to the camera. Do not copy the standing pose or previous legs. Camera/framing: Native square >=1024. Center body axis x=512 at 1024 target, reference ground pivot [512,942], generous margins; crown, hair, equipment and every boot contained. Whole character height about 870/1024; retain identity proportions exactly. Bright soft painted light. Actual clean transparent alpha.
No shadows, no floor, no checkerboard, no floating ornaments, no text, no borders, no crop, no panels. No purple/magenta/red matte fringe. Preserve true red costume; only edge contamination is unwanted. Newly DRAW the stepping legs, bent knees, soles and cloth for this phase. Do not translate/warp/recolor/reuse the same standing pose; never create two poses or a sprite sheet. This is one distinct complete walking frame. Highest visual finish supported by the host.

note: Tool exposes no model or quality selector. Reference 1 is derived unchanged identity inspection from original 4096 portrait; no action count.
